integrity: All assertions are mathematical theorems about the specified mechanism, not empirical predictions. Finite computational checks support but do not replace the proofs; model-specific applications of established Gibbs and majorization methods are acknowledged. No independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact equilibrium of independent unit hops on a finite symmetric cycle with quenched bounded depths. Nonuniform depths and at least two units for strictness; fixed positive temperature, i.i.d uniform depths and positive wealth density for the thermodynamic mixed-Poisson theorem. Does not characterize finite-time Monte Carlo peaks, interacting money exchange, or vanishing-temperature joint limits.
title: Thermal inequality monotonicity and light-tailed equilibrium in a bounded trap-diffusion wealth model
